subject.title: fix(imessage): repair DM sender fallback before pairing

question: Should this sender-fallback repair fail closed before access control when sender normalizes to destination_caller_id but no distinct peer can be confidently recovered?
rationale: The sender value is the authorization subject and reply target, so accepting an unrepaired local-sender payload is a security and message-delivery boundary choice rather than a purely mechanical refactor.

options.title: Require Normalized Repair Or Drop
options.body: Require canonical handle normalization and drop unrepairable local-sender DM payloads before access control.

options.title: Repair Only With Explicit Peer
options.body: Allow the PR to repair only when a distinct peer is present and accept the remaining local-sender fallback risk with live proof.

options.title: Pause For Narrower Root Cause
options.body: Pause this branch if the author's current failures are a different iMessage root cause that needs a separate fix.

recommendation.title: Require Normalized Repair Or Drop
recommendation.body: Require canonical handle normalization and drop unrepairable local-sender DM payloads before access control.

likelyOwner.reason: The current sender-repair, normalization, and inbound-processing lines are in the recent iMessage area rewrite attributed to this owner signal.
